item.name: [SETUP] Delete fixtures created by this run

exec: pm.test("Cleanup uses only explicitly tracked IDs", function () { pm.expect(ids).to.be.an("array"); });

ids.forEach(id => pm.sendRequest({url: `${pm.environment.get("baseUrl") || pm.collectionVariables.get("baseUrl")}/booking/${id}`, method: "DELETE", header: {"Authorization": `Basic ${basic}`}}, function (err, res) { pm.test(`[CLEANUP] Delete tracked ID ${id}`, function () { pm.expect(err).to.eql(null); pm.expect([201, 404, 405]).to.include(res.code); }); }));
